warnings: Every footing is printed 'F<n>, C2' — footing mark + the column stub C2 standing on it (C2 = 0.20x0.20, 6-DB12 on S-07). C2 is recorded here once (20 points); the floor-level columns are C1 on S-02 (18 points — the two porch points A'1/A'2' have only C2).

The sheet draws no grid lines inside the plan, only the bubbles and dimension chains; every footing position was read against the chains and cross-checked against the vector geometry of the cap outlines (all 20 caps land on grid intersections within 0.01 m).
Row A' (1.50 above A, S-01 chain) carries two F1 for the front porch (A'1, A'2'). Grid 2' is a printed named grid.
F2 caps (two piles, 0.90 x 0.36 on S-06) are all drawn with the 0.90 side along x.
